source_evidence: You can verify the registration of both publicly traded and non-traded REITs through the SEC’s EDGAR system. You can also use EDGAR to review a REIT’s annual and quarterly reports as well as any offering prospectus.
question: Misconception: If a REIT is listed in EDGAR, checking its registration is all the research needed.
answer: EDGAR can help you verify a REIT’s registration, and it can also be used to review the REIT’s annual and quarterly reports and any offering prospectus. Registration checking alone does not cover those other available materials.
